programme.desc: Teamet støder på endeløse problemer, mens de forsøger at skære et stykke ud af 60-fods-stenen.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Claudia ankommer med boreudstyr og har kun fire dage til at finde den bedste jade, men Robin og hende kan ikke blive enige om, hvor de skal lede.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Drengene kommer op og skændes, da tidspresset tvinger dem til at arbejde på to miner på én gang.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Teamet får jadesten op af J-linsen, men problemer med vejen truer hele operationen.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: At trække en 20-tons stenblok ud af minen viser sig at være for meget for deres gamle lastbil 6-Pack.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Da Claudia og Robins testboringer efter jade ikke giver resultater, kan selv virksomhedens geologer ikke blive enige om en plan.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Claudia, Robin og holdet kæmper for at få deres tunge udstyr op ad et bjerg, inden stigende floder gør det umuligt at nå minen.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Spændinger opstår under teamets kamp for at transportere tungt udstyr op ad en mudret, klippefyldt, 120 km lang sti for at etablere en ny jade-mine på bjergtoppen.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Teamet forsøger at få deres maskiner transportet over kraftigt stigende floder for at etablere deres nye jademine på en bjergtop.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Alan er overbevist om, at der er jade under en grube, der fyldt med vand, kaldet Dynasty.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.sub-title: Ingen Jade Før Blod Er Spildt
programme.desc: Robin forsøger at trodse fysikkens love for at få et stort, nyt mandskabsrum til deres Wolverine-mine.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: En række uheld forfølger Jade City-holdet, og alle forsøger at finder unikke løsninger på problermerne.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Alle bliver ellevilde, da de endelig begynder at grave lovende, grønne klippestykker op, som teamet tror er millioner værd.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Spændingerne koger over, da de oversøiske investorer dukker uventet op for at tjekke fremskridtet i Wolverine-minen, og Alan forsøger at skabe fred.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Efter endelig at have afdækket nogle lovende klippestykker ved Wolverine-minen, opdager teamet, at de måske har overtrådt minens grænser.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Stressniveauet stiger i takt med at afslutningen på mine-sæsonen nærmer sig, og Jade City-teamet forsøger at finde den store jade-gevinst.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.sub-title: Det Er Ikke Let At Finde Grønt
programme.desc: Temperaturer under frysepunktet udfordrer Jade City-minearbejderne, der kæmper for at finde jackpotten-en jade-klippe stor nok til at imponere investorerne-inden sæsonen slutter.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Claudia og Robins uprøvede maskiner begynder at bryde sammen under den brutale tur op til Wolverine-minen.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Teamet forsøger at krydse svulmende floder, for at få deres maskiner op til minen, mens Josh falder bagud i sin gravemaskine, der konstant har problemer.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Josh er strandet på den lange sti til Wolverine-minen, da dele af hans gravemaskine falder af og han har ikke nogen muligheder for at tilkalde hjælp.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Minensæsonen starter, og mens jaden viser sig at være svær at finde, bringer en lastbilulykke held til Jade City.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Guy bliver efterladt med ansvaret for Wolverine-minen, hvor introduktionen af en ny arbejder truer med at ødelægge hans mission om at finde sæsonens første jade.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Mens Wolverine-teamet strammer op på deres sikkerhedsprocedurer, kollapser den nye medarbejder, Jay, hvilket afslører problemerne i deres nødberedskab.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Josh er strandet i den nye gravemaskine, mens en bunke værdiløse klippestykker får Claudia til at overveje en ny strategi.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Alan bringer en gruppe købere til Jade City, hvilket får Claudias team til at gå i panik i deres forsøg på at finde sæsonens første salgbare jade-klippestykker.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Mens holdet kæmper sig gennem mudder for at finde en klippe, der er millioner værd, risikerer Josh at miste udstyr for en halv million dollars i forsøget på at få hans lastbil op af en grøft.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Teamet finder sæsonens bedste jade-klippe, men risikerer at underminere dens værdi, da de forsøger at fjerne alle revnerne.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Claudias søn Justin viser, at han har næse for jade, mens Scrappy Larry, Robin og Josh kæmper for at få deres ødelagte lastbil væk fra stien til Wolverine.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: En række skuffelser tvinger Robin og Justin på en sidste desperat jagt efter jade-klippestykker for at redde sæsonen, mens Scrappy Larry skynder sig for at få en dieseltank ombygget.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Claudias projekt med at huse et arbejdshold i Jade City er truet, da septiktanken bryder sammen og forurener drikkevandet.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Det kolde vejr starter tidligt og gælden hober sig op, mens teamet kæmper for at få en enorm og potentielt sæson-reddende klippe transporteret hen til lejren.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Med årets mest lovende klippe bliver bearbejdet ved Wolverine, crasher Josh og R2 deres lastbil, hvilket efterlader Claudia og teamet i chok.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Kapløbet er i gang for at komme ud af Wolverine-lejren, inden sneen begraver det hele.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Claudia bliver tvunget til at køre lastbilen, mens hendes hold kæmper sig op ad den stenede sti til deres bjergtop-jadelejr, Wolverine.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Spændingerne koger over, da Claudia, Robin og teamet forsøger at få mennesker og udstyr til deres fjerntliggende jade-lejr.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK

programme.title: Hvor ondskab bor: My Son's Prisoner
programme.desc: Shelly Lietz har været bange for sin søn, siden han var fire. Det blev kun værre, da han voksede op, og hun en dag var fange i sit eget hjem.

programme.title: People Magazine Investigates: Jenner Beach Murders
programme.desc: En dejlig weekendtur udvikler sig til et grusomt dobbeltmord på et ungt kristent par.

programme.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit: Zebras
programme.desc: Mordet på en turist i Central Park bringer enheden i højeste alarmberedskab. Men da den mistænkte, som de har bragt ind til afhøring.

programme.title: Murder in the Heartland: Homicide Hotel
programme.desc: Da natreceptionisten Mary Klatt bliver brutalt kvalt på sit arbejde, kan ingen i lokalsamfundet forestille sig, at nogen ville gøre hende fortræd.

programme.title: My Lottery Dream Home: Carolina Beach Legacy House
programme.desc: Et par vil invester en arv i et strandhus. De har brug for Davids hjælp til at finde det helt rigtige sted i Carolina Beach, North Carolina.

programme.title: Renovating Mississippi
programme.desc: Ben og Erin hjælper Laurels første gæster med at vælge mellem en renovering og nybyggeri.

programme.title: Mother & Daughter Renovate: A Charred Charmer for Cory
programme.desc: Cory elsker mulighederne i et 100 år gammelt hus, men kan brænde fingrene på de alvorlige brand- og fundamentskader.

programme.title: My Lottery Dream Home: Luck Comes In Pairs
programme.desc: Et pars søn vandt $100.000 i lotto, men et år senere vandt de selv $2 millioner! David hjælper dem med at finde et hjem i Richmond, Virginia.

programme.title: My Lottery Dream Home: The Wizard of Cape Coral
programme.desc: David er tilbage i Cape Coral, Florida. Men orkanen Ian har ødelagt området. Nu skal David lave drømme til virkelighed.

programme.title: My Lottery Dream Home: Anything You Want in Vermont
programme.desc: Efter en arv vil et par købe en ejendom i Vermont. David træder til og finder hjem fulde af charme i det betagende bjerglandskab.

programme.title: My Lottery Dream Home: Big Kona Energy
programme.desc: De fleste drømmer om at vinde den helt store lottogevinst - og for dem, der vinder, bliver drømmehjemmet med fem soveværelser pludselig en mulighed.

programme.title: Renoveringsdrømme - Sverige: Drømmegården i Tärnsjö
programme.desc: Vi møder et nyt par, der efter fem års venten endelig har købt deres drømmegård i Tärnsjö. Erik og Anneli modtager nyheder.

programme.title: Fixer to Fabulous: Fix This $5K Cabin
programme.desc: Dave og Jenny Marrs omfavner deres nabolag i Arkansas, hvor de renoverer de klassiske og historiske huse.

programme.title: Fixer Upper: Welcome Home: Mediterranean Money Pit
programme.desc: Chip og Jo møder uventede udfordringer med at omdanne en pengesluger ved Middelhavet til en toskansk oase.

programme.title: Helicopter ER
programme.desc: Luftambulancen rykker ud for at redde en hårdt tilskadekommen ung chauffør. Derudover bruger holdet en usædvanlig teknik til at redde en mand.

programme.title: Holiday Crashers
programme.desc: To bedste venner har det sjovt sammen med at crashe julefester. Lige indtil deres opdigtede identiteter fanger dem i et net af løgne - og kærlighed.

programme.title: The Christmas Quest
programme.desc: En arkæolog og hendes eksmand leder efter en skat på Island til jul. Det bliver et kapløb om at sikre skatten, før de forkerte personer får fat i den.

programme.title: Holiday Touchdown: A Chiefs Love Story
programme.desc: Alanas familie er fans af Kansas City Chiefs og vil gerne vinde cheerleading-konkurrencen. Da hun møder dommer Derrick, er det starten på noget mere.

programme.title: The Finnish Line
programme.desc: Anya deltager i sin fars sidste hundeslædeløb i Finland, men hendes førerhund er skadet. Sammen med Coles hund kæmper hun mod sin fars rival, Monty.

programme.title: Sugarplummed
programme.desc: Emilys juleønske går i opfyldelse, da en filmstjerne træder frem fra det store lærred for at hjælpe. Hun indser snart, at den perfekte jul ikke findes.

programme.title: Hvor ondskab bor: First Love, Forever Evil
programme.desc: Melissa Holland giftede sig med sin gymnasiekæreste og troede, det var hendes livs lykke. Men han bragte hurtigt hendes liv i fare.

programme.title: Hvor ondskab bor: The Monster I Married
programme.desc: Da Cindy forelskede sig i Bobby i gymnasiet, var det, som om lynet slog ned. Hun havde aldrig troet, han en dag ville begå frygtelige forbrydelser.

programme.desc: Et dårligt timet sammenbrud på en øde vejstrækning ender katastrofalt for en collegestuderende.

programme.title: Key & Peele: The Job Interview
programme.desc: Dommer Jessie har et nyt program, en mand venter på sit jobinterview, to damer sludrer, parkeringsvagter diskuterer Val Kilmer, en pensioneret mand fra hæren hører om et nyt projekt og en kvinde introducerer sin forlovede for sine forældre.

programme.title: Key & Peele: MMMMMM

programme.title: Key & Peele: East Bowl Rap / West Bowl Rap
programme.sub-title: East Bowl Rap / West Bowl Rap
programme.desc: Sketches inkluderer All-Stars fra East/West bowl, der rapper, fyrene spiller mafioso, og de to parkeringsfyre har svært ved at tro, at nogen tør provokere Batmans.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Sex Addict Wendel
programme.desc: Artister bliver sparket i skridtet på grund af deres kunst, klassens klovn terroriserer læreren og en mand prøver at få heldet med sig til et møde for sexmisbrugere.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Gang Stand-Off
programme.desc: Sketches inkluderer gangstere, der er vilde med 'Twilight,' besøg til en verden, hvor navnene er prutter og racistiske superhelte.

programme.title: Key & Peele: The 420 Special
programme.desc: Neil deGrasse Tyson slapper af derhjemme, Keegan må bevare fatningen under et jobinterview, en skrædder får en klient med luft i maven, parkeringsvagterne diskuterer 'Game of Thrones' og en telefonsælger prøver en ny strategi.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Bitch
programme.desc: I denne seriepremiere af komedieprogrammet prøver Jordan Peele og Keegan Michael Key at sige et forbudt ord om deres kvinder, Lil Wayne vænner sig til livet bag tremmer og præsident Obama udtrykker, hvad han virkelig føler.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Aerobics Meltdown
programme.desc: Stan Lee har nogle nye superhelte, en sej fyr mister sin street cred, når han oplever en hjernefrys. Sidst, men ikke mindst, udvikler en mand en kompliceret mindesanordning for at huske, hvor han har parkeret.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Scariest Movie Ever
programme.desc: A vampyr afslører sig selv, en seriemorder bliver bremset og et barn får sit ønske opfyldt.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Non-Stop Party
programme.desc: Sketches inkluderer en fyr, der jagter sin kæreste til Jordens ende og LMFAO, der ikke kan holde op med at feste.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Obama Shutdown
programme.desc: Sketches inkluderer Keegan, der bliver lidt for høj, en fodboldspiller, der vil gøre alt for at få det røde kort, og to sexeksperter, der giver råd om cunnilingus.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Y'all Ready For This?
programme.desc: Et football-hold hyper sig før en kamp, president Obama og Luther møder Hillary Clinton, to fyre forbereder sig på potentielle trusler på et fly, pirater synger en sang og en betjent er lidt for skydeglad.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Manly Tears
programme.desc: Sketches inkluderer en narkohandel, der går galt, en mafiafyr, der er en stor tudemarie, og Darius Rucker, der prøver at håndterer sin Hootie-fortid.

programme.title: Key & Peele: The Branding
programme.desc: Jordan og Keegan udforsker oplevelsen som sort collegestuderende og snyltegæster, som succes medfører. Andre sketches inkluderer et kvartes reaktion på et mystisk væsen, hvornår man kan - og ikke kan - sige et kontroversielt ord.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Parole Officer Puppet
programme.desc: En tilsynsværge bruger en dukke til at knytte bånd til en i hans varetægt, en mand med nakkestøtte prøver at feste løs og en soldat har en følelsesladet genforening med sin familie.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Pussy On The Chainwax
programme.desc: Sketches inkluderer Keegan, der bliver distraheret, mens han taler i telefon med sin kæreste, Keegan og Jordan har en ond chef og tilblivelsen af et nyt udtryk.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Terrorist Meeting
programme.desc: A gangster prøver desperat at bevise, han er skør, terrorister mødes for at planlægge deres næste træk og en jaloux storebror gør en familiemiddag pinlig.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Obama College Years
programme.desc: Jordan og Keegan befinder sig pludselig i en genopførsel af Borgerkrigen, Jesus møder en farlig alfons, og vi får set præsident Barack Obama de første år på college.

programme.title: Key & Peele: The Power of Wings
programme.desc: Inkluderer sketcher hvor Keegan og Jordan aflytter hvide kvinder, der elsker sorte mænd, Wendell laver en musikvideo, og Kareem og Jahar går i fitnesscenteret.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Meegan & Andre Break Up
programme.desc: To venner kommer i klammeri på en klub, Meegan og André har en seriøs samtale, en rapper går fra et interview, Conrad flyver business class og Keegan har et nyt overskæg.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Old Ladies And Satan
programme.desc: To gamle damer slås mod Satan, ting går galt når en mand vil købe en ny madras og gæsterne på en klub tvinges til at se sandheden om sig selv.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Slap-Ass: In Recovery
programme.desc: En baseballspiller kæmper mod sin afhængighed af at klaske røv, en mafioso tager hævn og Steve Urkel driver en mand til vanvid.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Soul Food
programme.desc: Jordan og Keegan diskuterer, hvem der er mest sort og når man er den eneste sorte fyr til en fest. Sketches inkluderer Tea Party, der opdager et nyt håb, hærens hververe, der tænker anderledes, og Bobby McFerrin, der dyster mod Michael Winslow.

programme.title: Key & Peele
programme.desc: Jordan og Keegan har en flickerkamp og en MMA-fighter går for vidt, når han disser modstanderen. Andre sketches inkluderer en bryllupsgæst, der vil være dj og spille 'klassiske' numre.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Sex Detective

programme.title: Langt fra Bryggen: Episode 101

programme.title: Langt fra Bryggen: Episode 102

programme.desc: Sangene inkluderer: "Don't Speak "Ex-Girlfriend" "Just A Girl" "Simple Kind of Life" "Sunday Morning" og "Trapped In A Box".

programme.title: MTV Cribs International: Tom Zanetti; Lottie Tomlinson
programme.desc: Tom Zanetti viser sit hjem på Ibiza; Sociale-medier-influencer Lottie Tomlinson.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling og Lolo Wood CLXXVIII
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af Ridiculousness laver Rob, Steelo og Lolo Wood stunt i køkkenet i KØKKENAKROBATER.

programme.title: Caught In The Act: Unfaithful
programme.desc: Mimi, en danser, der arbejder sent, har bemærket skummel opførsel fra Memphis, hendes kæreste gennem seks år. Før hun siger ja ved alteret.

programme.title: Caught In The Act: Unfaithful: Rigtige mænd tager ansvar
programme.desc: Jecarah får Tami til at undersøge, om forplantningspresset skræmmer Ikenna væk... eller trækker nogen ham ind til sig?

programme.title: Ink Master: Tilbage til tegnebrættet
programme.desc: Kampen om en salon fortsætter, da deltagerne tatoverer dyr fra hjembyen. Nogle må tilbage til tegnebrættet, og slaget er kun lige begyndt.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling og Nina Agdal LXXVIII
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af Ridiculousness drømmer Rob, Steelo og Nina Agdal om at ramme jorden i Sovefald.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling og Carly Aquilino LXXXV
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af Ridiculousness prøver Rob, Steelo og Carly Aquilino at hoppe højt, men har Elendige afsæt.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling og Carly Aquilino LXXXVI
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af Ridiculousness har Rob, Steelo og Carly Aquilino problemer med lyset i Lampeklask.

programme.desc: Nyd dette akustiske set fra det legendariske rockband Aerosmith på Ed Sullivan Theatre i New York. Numrene er blandt andet "Toys In The Attic.

programme.title: Robinson Ekspeditionen
programme.desc: I Striden kæmper holdene om en lækker frugtkurv. Men sejrens sødme overskygges af dramatiske hændelser, der får stor betydning for flere af ekspeditionens overlevere.

programme.title: Robinson Ekspeditionen
programme.desc: Med blot 4 overlevere tilbage på Hold Syd, ryster Jakob Kjeldbjerg posen, når de to hold kæmper om en hemmelighedsfuld kiste. Kisten får store konsekvenser for både Nord- og Sydboerne.

programme.title: Robinson Ekspeditionen
programme.desc: En kammerat fra hver strand får det store ansvar, når de skal kæmpe i Dysten med hele holdets pres hvilende på deres skuldre. Taberen sender både sig selv og sit eget hold i Ørådet.

programme.title: Robinson Ekspeditionen
programme.desc: Ekspeditionen er slut for flere af deltagerne – men efterspillet er kun lige begyndt. I Robinson EXIT følger vi deltagerne tæt, når de vender tilbage til virkeligheden.

programme.title: Robinson Ekspeditionen
programme.desc: En ny epoke i Ekspeditionen nærmer sig, og hold syd kæmper for at opnå en sejr, inden holdene opløses.

programme.title: Robinson Ekspeditionen
programme.desc: Det er tid til sammenlægning, men først skal deltagerne igennem et skæbnesvangert Øråd, hvor intet er som det plejer. Bølgerne går højt, når endnu en deltager må forlade ekspeditionen.

programme.title: Robinson Ekspeditionen
programme.desc: Jakob Kjeldbjerg åbner Robinson Ekspeditionen med kompromisløs autoritet, når deltagerne fra start skal træffe svære fravalg af hinanden inden den første holdkonkurrence.

programme.title: Robinson Ekspeditionen
programme.desc: Efter blot få dage på stranden skal det tabende hold i Dysten beslutte, hvem der bliver den første til at forlade Robinson Ekspeditionen 2026.

programme.title: Robinson Ekspeditionen
programme.desc: Overleverne skal endnu engang træffe svære fravalg, når en fra hvert hold sendes til Forhandling. Forhandlingen får store konsekvenser for to af Ekspeditionens deltagere.

programme.title: Robinson Ekspeditionen
programme.desc: I ni dage har overleverne kun levet af den sparsomme kost, de selv har kunnet fange i den vilde natur. Derfor er motivationen stor i Striden, når den første madpræmie er på spil.

programme.title: Simba: Helt ærligt

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 607
programme.desc: Bjergområdet Bjørnfjell uden for Narvik bugner med fritidsaktiviteter, både sommer og vinter. Teamet tager denne gang fat i en godt brugt hjælpekorpshytte, der desperat har brug for kærlighed.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 608
programme.desc: I smukke Numedal med udsigt over Uvdal ligger familien Bjerkes hytte. Men den skal nu forvandles fra en typisk norsk hytte til en hyggelig amerikansk lodge.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 609
programme.desc: Denne gang er der fisk på menuen. På øen Frei ud for Kristiansund møder vi Furseth-familien og deres gamle klipfiskemole – og Halvor viser både sin kreativitet og sine madlavningsevner.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 610
programme.desc: Ved søen Tyin ligger Benedicte og Jon Olavs hytte idyllisk. Men der skal foretages store ændringer både ude og inde, når teamet afprøver nye kreative løsninger og hemmelige rum.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 701
programme.desc: Gutterne rejser til idylliske Nesdal i Lodalen. De vil forvandle en stor bondegård til et hyggeligt sommerhus. Halvor viser, hvordan små ændringer kan gøre en stor forskel.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 702
programme.desc: Denne gang går turen til det smukke Os uden for Bergen. En hytte trænger desperat til en stilændring, og gutterne får virkelig mulighed for at bruge deres kreative evner.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 703
programme.desc: Foreholmen er en skjult perle i Flekkefjord. En mørk hytte er forvandles til et lyst sommerparadis.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 704
programme.desc: Gutterne tager til det eksotiske Sommarøy uden for Tromsø for at forvandle en gammel lade til et smukt feriehus. Halvor laver lamper af stråhatte, og Ole og Torkel bruger tømmeret fra den gamle lade på en kreativ måde.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 705
programme.desc: Gutternes næste eventyr fører dem til Halvors hjemegn Nevlunghavn. Her har et ungt par arvet familiens sommerhus, og de ønsker en moderne og mere personlig stil.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 706
programme.desc: Oppe i bjergene med en fantastisk udsigt over Glomfjord finder vi Glomfjord Alpinsenters hytte. Træhytten trænger desperat til lidt kærlighed, så gutterne pakker deres ski og går igang.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 707
programme.desc: I Rennebu ligger der en gård med en gammel bjælkehytte, der ligner et feriehus i Caribien. Fyrene ønsker at finde husets sjæl og må tænke kreativt for at opnå den ultimative kombination af moderne og traditionelt.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 708
programme.desc: Fra stuevinduet ser du lige op mod Gaustatoppen. Gutterne installerer større vinduer, men sørger også for at hytten er hyggelig og tæt på naturen. En overraskelse til faren venter i annekset.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 801
programme.desc: Vi tager en tur til det smukke Orre på Jæren uden for Stavanger. Torkel bygger et smart læskur til blæsende dage, og Ole og Halvor får en sjov idé med at flette terracottafliser ind i trægulvet.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 802
programme.desc: Mændene tager til Ytre Fure på Stadlandet for at lave en gammel schweizervilla om til et idyllisk og praktisk sommerhus. Halvor lærer Ole at tapetsere, og Ole har spændende planer for den gamle lade.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 803
programme.desc: Urke er en lille landsby ved siden af Hjørundfjorden. Her ligger programmets første A-formede hytte. Der skal bl.a. bygges en glasboks med store vinduer til den nye spisestue og laves ovenlysvinduer.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 804
programme.desc: Mændene rejser for første gang til Finnmark, nærmere bestemt Bugøynes. Hytten sammenlignes med "huset på prærien", og ord som "wild west" og "Ralph Lauren" bruges til at beskrive den ønskede stil.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 805
programme.desc: Lige uden for Halden ligger et sted kaldet Aremark, og her giver et ungt par Halvor frie tøjler til at renovere deres skovhytte. Torkel fælder et træ, som bliver lavet om til både bænk, bord og kunst.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 806
programme.desc: Dette års vinterhytte har udsigt over Vågå og er en typisk 80'er fyrretræshytte. Hytten er klar til at blive renoveret, og Halvor viser, hvordan man kan genbruge gamle vinduer og give møbler nyt liv.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 901
programme.desc: Sæsonens første afsnit tager os med til smukke Rott i Tananger. Her er et gammelt "jærhus" ved at blive renoveret. Der bliver bl.a. ændret i grundplanen, og Ole bygger et hyggeligt udhus.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 902
programme.desc: I dette afsnit går turen til det populære sommerhusområde Hvaler, hvor holdet skal forvandle et sjælløst sommerhus til et maritimt paradis.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 903
programme.desc: For enden af et fjeld ved Tjomsland i Larvik kommune ligger et sommerhus, som man næsten ikke kan se. Holdet genbruger mere end normalt, men hytten er stadig helt uigenkendelig, når ugen er omme.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 903
programme.desc: For enden af et fjeld ved Tjomsland i Larvik kommune ligger et sommerhus, som man næsten ikke kan se. Holdet genbruger mere end normalt, men hytten er stadig helt uigenkendelig, når ugen er omme.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 904
programme.desc: Holdet rejser til Hurum for at renovere et lille sommerhus med mange smalle rum. Der skal åbnes op, og selvfølgelig skal huset have en ny farve. Halvor viser, hvordan man kan genbruge møbler.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 904
programme.desc: Holdet rejser til Hurum for at renovere et lille sommerhus med mange smalle rum. Der skal åbnes op, og selvfølgelig skal huset have en ny farve. Halvor viser, hvordan man kan genbruge møbler.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 905
programme.desc: Lige uden for Stavanger ligger Randøy, og her finder man et sommerhus med en lidt usædvanlig form. Ejerne bakser med en stor trappe, der tager meget plads, men holdet har en løsning.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 905
programme.desc: Lige uden for Stavanger ligger Randøy, og her finder man et sommerhus med en lidt usædvanlig form. Ejerne bakser med en stor trappe, der tager meget plads, men holdet har en løsning.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 906
programme.desc: Med udsigt over Åsenfjorden ligger en lille sommerhusgrund med 3 huse. Her bor en stor familie, som gerne vil have et pænere udendørs fællesområde samt en renovering af det ældste hus.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 906
programme.desc: Med udsigt over Åsenfjorden ligger en lille sommerhusgrund med 3 huse. Her bor en stor familie, som gerne vil have et pænere udendørs fællesområde samt en renovering af det ældste hus.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 907
programme.desc: Holdet er endelig tilbage på Svalbard. Sommerhuset, som de skal renovere, har udsigt over Adventdalen og Mine 7. Projektet tager en dramatisk drejning, da en isbjørn bliver spottet i området.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 907
programme.desc: Holdet er endelig tilbage på Svalbard. Sommerhuset, som de skal renovere, har udsigt over Adventdalen og Mine 7. Projektet tager en dramatisk drejning, da en isbjørn bliver spottet i området.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: While working on a robbery case, Kelly calls for police assistance when she observes the thieves escaping. A shootout occurs and one of the thieves, Joe Willow, escapes after killing a cop. Sgt. Cates takes his anger and frustration home where he batters his son, Greg. When Kelly realizes that Cates beats his son, she confronts the Sgt. and presses for child abuse charges. Joe Willow's underworld friends, Stone and Burke, observe the welfare court case awarding Kelly temporary custody of Greg while Cates works on the murder case. The thugs kidnap Kelly and Greg and attempt to persuade Cates to drop the search for Willow. Kelly manipulates her telephone answering service to alert the Angels and Cates to her house where she is being held captive. In the ensuing shootout, Kelly and Greg escape and the Angels apprehend the thugs and Willow. Cates admits his problem and is reunited with his son.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.sub-title: One Of Our Angels Is Missing
programme.desc: Bondsman Harry Silvers hires the Angels to locate accused jewel thief Ray Devlin, who has fled, jumping bail. Using a cover as a wealthy divorcee, Kris is to lure Devlin from an Arizona resort back to Los Angeles.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Tennessean Seth Jeffers follows his girlfriend, Bess Murdock, to Los Angeles and discovers she is acting in porno movies. But when Seth disappears, the Angels are called to investigate. Kelly discovers a showbill with Bess' picture and the producer's name, Joe Willis. Kris approaches Willis and the Angels find and question Bess, who knows nothing about Seth's disappearance. Willis orders the Angels killed and they barely escape death in an auto accident. Kris steals a copy of Willis' movie and upon recognizing the locale, she has police comb the area for Jeffers' body. Bess overhears Willis tell his thugs how to handle police questions about Jeffers. She confronts him, but cannot escape Joe's plans to photograph her own death on film. Kris arrives in time to interrupt the shooting and following a brief shootout, the Angels arrive to apprehend the whole crew. A shaken Bess recuperates and returns home to Tennessee.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: When a wealthy Beverly Hills couple is robbed of valuable Egyptian art treasures, the Angels suspect the dapper real estate baron, Barry Kingsbrook. Kris infiltrates the Kingsbrook Agency as an agent and the Angels set up a phony house listing to lure Barry to Tiffany's supposed priceless collection of revolutionary period letters. Barry sets a deal with Bosley who poses as a wealthy collector willing to buy letters. Barry's assistant, Tina, tells him that Kris is a plant and while Tina shows Tiffany's house to prospective buyers (including the thieves) Barry takes Kris to his house where he attempts to drug her drink. The Angels capture the thieves and persuade Tina to tell where Kris is located. As the Angels arrive at Barry's house, they find that Kris has beaten Barry into confessing his role in previous thefts for money used to pay his enormous gambling debts.

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: Tabitha gets an assist from her grandmother when Endora casts a spell that turns her into a 7year-old super genius.

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.sub-title: A Good Turn Never Goes Unpunished
programme.desc: Samantha and Darrin argue over the use of witchcraft in an ad campaign.

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: Old Chines proverb: Witch should blink softly and never touch cinnamon stick.

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.sub-title: The Truth, Nothing But The Truth, So Help Me Sam
programme.desc: Endora casts a "truth spell" on a gift from Darrin to Samantha that causes everyone embarrassment.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.sub-title: I, Darrin, Take This Witch Samantha
programme.desc: Samantha and Darrin appear to be an ideally matched couple. Very much in love, they decide to marry. Darrin doesn't know that Samantha, is, of all things, a witch. On their wedding night, Samantha's mother, Endora, a witch, of course, visits her daughter. Regretting that her daughter has married a mortal, she is bent on breaking up the marriage. After pleading with her mother not to interfere, Samantha decides to tell her husband that he has unknowingly married a witch. To convince Darrin of her magic powers, Samantha performs a series of tricks. Darrin makes her promise never to practice her witchcraft again. Sheila, a former girl friend of Darrin's, invites the newly-weds to a dinner party. She makes every effort to embarrass Samantha before the guests. After enduring Sheila's snubs and insults, Samantha cannot resist evening the score. She employs her extraordinary powers to humiliate Sheila. Later, at home, Darrin rebukes his wife, but admits Sheila deserved the tricks played on her.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Endora is disgusted when Samantha refuses to use supernatural powers to cope with the routine tasks of a suburban housewife.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.sub-title: It Shouldn't Happen to a Dog
programme.desc: Samantha gives a dinner party to impress Rex Barker, one of Darrin's clients. Rex brings along his date, Babs Livingston, but advances on Samantha in the garden when he gets drunk.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Gladys Kravitz, a neighbor, is unable to convince her husband, Abner, that strange things seem to be happening at the Stephens' home. Gladys, June Foster, and Shirley Clyde, with their sons, visit the Stephens' home to welcome Samantha to the community. Gladys is frustrated in her attempts to point out to her friends the amazing number of objects which seem to appear and disappear. When the boys pester Endora, Samantha's mother, she uses magic to tie the three of them up. On leaving, Gladys tries to point out to her friends that it would be physically impossible for three boys to tie themselves up. Later Darrin returns home for his first meeting with Endora. Endora and Darrin soon engage in a heated argument about their opposing viewpoints on life. Endora threatens to turn Darrin into as artichoke. Later Samantha expresses her love for Darrin by announcing that if Endora had done so, she would also have turned herself into an artichoke.

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: Darrin struggles for days to create an advertising campaign for Caldwell Soup. Samantha's suggestions seem perfect, but Darrin's pride leads him to suspect Witchcraft. Stubborn, Darrin presents his own ideas to Phillip Caldwell, who rejects them. Samantha, worn out with housework, is stung when Darrin accuses her of using witchcraft to do that too. Endora, Samantha's mother, who dislikes Darrin, is pleased when the couple quarrels, and Samantha, packing in her own curious fashion, walks out. Crushed at losing his wife and a client in one week, Darrin submits Samantha's ideas to Larry Tate, his boss, who thinks they are great. Tate is bewildered when Darrin ecstatically accepts Caldwell's rejection and dashes home to make up with Samantha. Darrin then uses Samantha's chance remark as the basin for a successful Caldwell Soup campaign, blissfully unaware that Samantha planned it just that way.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Darrin discovers that Samantha has been entertaining a guest each morning after he leaves for work. the guest is ten year old Marshall Burns. Marshall's mother is a widow, whose over-protectiveness has robbed Marshall of all his self-confidence. Darrin tells Samantha that she has no right to interfere with Mrs. Burns' upbringing of her son. Despite Marshall's belief that he is no good at anything, Samantha takes him to a Junior League ball game. Marshall has never been able to make the team. Floyd Kravitz, nephew of Gladys Kravitz, is the star player. With a little witchery on Samantha's part, Marshall becomes a triple threat. When his mother, fearful that he may be inured, forbids him to play, Marshall runs away from home. Samantha and Darrin drive Mrs. Burns to the ball field. There, Marshall, in his own right, has continued to star. How-ever, when Marshall gets into a tight spot, Darrin forbids Samantha from interfering. Marshall makes it on his own. Proud of her son, Mrs. Burns is not unhappy when Coach Gribben suggests that he visit the Burns home to give Marshall some extra coaching.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Samantha, her friends, Bertha and Mary, and her Aunt Clara, all witches, decide to change the popular conception of witches into a more flattering image. Their opportunity arises when Darrin, an ad man, is assigned to devise a trademark for a new type of Halloween candy. Mr. Brinkman, the promoter of the candy, wants the trademark to show a traditional witch. Darrin at first agrees, but when he sees how upset Samantha becomes, he decides to present a beautiful witch. Mr. Brinkman objects, but Darrin refuses to yield. Con-sequently, he is fired. The witches decide to practice some of their pranks on Mr. Brinkman. As a topper, they transform him into an ugly old witch. Mr. Brinkman finally admits that his idea of witches is wrong. He agrees to use a glamorous witch for his trademark. Samantha wins her point, and Darrin wins back his job.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Teenager Liza Randall interviews Darrin about his career in advertising for a school newspaper. After Darrin takes Liza to the agency on Saturday, Liza's jealous boy friend, Marvin "Monster" Grogan, visits Samantha. Monster, a football star, wants to batter Darrin. Samantha, stuffing Monster with food, explains the innocence of Darrin and Lisa's relationship, although she knows Liza is more than interested in Darrin. At the office, Liza pours drinks. Liza and Darrin are doused when Darrin tries to take the drink away from her. Darrin escapes an awkward situation when boss Larry Tate arrives with two prospective clients . Meanwhile, Monster takes a romantic interest in Samantha. Darrin and Liza arrive, reeking of liquor. Darrin accuses Samantha of playing up to Monster. Samantha taunts him about Liza. However, when Monster winds up to clout Darrin, he bruises his hands on the invisible shield Samantha has created. When Liza slaps Darrin, however, Samantha lets him get the full force of the blow. Later Samantha removes her own protective shield when Darrin tries to make up.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Darrin's workload piles sky-high when Larry Tate and his wife Louise fly to Paris to cover the fashion showings- for a client. Samantha spends most of the time alone playing solitaire. She accepts Endora's invitation to fly to Paris, without a plane, of course, for lunch. In Paris, Samantha and Endora run into the Tates. Larry is surprised, phones Darrin that Samantha and her mother are in Paris with them. Samantha returns home immediately. Darrin tells Samantha their marriage is a mistake, since he has taken her away from all the high living she seems to love. Although Samantha tries to convinces Darrin that he is wrong, she angrily leaves, and returns to Paris. Larry Tate tells Darrin Samantha is lonesome for him. Darrin decides to follow her to Paris. After several unsuccessful tries, Samantha gets on Darrin's plane, and they arrive in Paris together.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Endora tells Samantha that Maurice, her father, is coming to visit. Endora warns Samantha that Maurice will be furious when he learns his daughter has married a mortal. Samantha, determined to stand up to her father, gets Darrin to stay in town on the night Maurice calls. Samantha tells Maurice that her husband is in Washington. The conversation about Darrin proceeds nicely until Maurice surmises Darrin is a mortal. Meanwhile, Darrin, who has been drinking with Larry Tate, phones Samantha and tells her he is coming home. When Darrin arrives, Maurice's fury hits its peak. Al-though Maurice admires Darrin's courage in facing up to him, he makes him disappear. Samantha, expressing her love for Darrin, pleads with Maurice to bring him back. Even Endora joins in Samantha's pleas. Although he tells them it will be extremely difficult, Maurice makes Darrin reappear. Before leaving, Maurice joins his family in a champagne toast. Im-pressed by the rare vintage, Maurice feels Darrin might be one of them after all.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.sub-title: It Takes One To Know One
programme.desc: When Darrin starts searching for a "Miss Jasmine" for his firm's perfume account, Endora seizes the opportunity to sew doubt in Samantha's mind about her husband's loyalty. The search for a beautiful model ends when Jannine Fleur arrives. Both Larry and Darrin agree that Jannine is "Miss Jasmine." Samantha learns that Jannine is a witch whom Endora has asked to captivate Darrin. Samantha warns Jannine to keel away from Darrin. Jannine, intrigued, keeps on with her original assign-ment. Darrin uses Larry Tate as his chaperone to keep him from becoming involved with Jannine. Darrin and Larry go to Jannine's apartment to discuss details of the "Miss Jasmine" campaign. Jannine doctors the drinks. Larry falls asleep and Darrin becomes amorous. Just as Darrin starts to kiss Jannine, Samantha uses her witchcraft, and Darrin appears to Jannine as a large ugly fish. When the campaign is completed, Samantha turns the picture of "Miss Jasmine" into a caricature of Jannine.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Larry and Louise Tate have been married for sixteen years and have no children. Louise asks Samantha to go with her to an obstetrician as tests have shown she is going to be a mother. Louise tells Samantha she is afraid to tell Larry since she believes he hates children. Larry, visiting his dentist at the medical center, sees Louise and Samantha enter the obstetrician's office. Thinking Samantha is going to have a baby, he tells Darrin, but cautions him not to say anything until Samantha tells him. In a reverie, Darrin visualizes his children as little witches. He comes to with a sinking feeling. Samantha invites the Tates to dinner. Both Larry and Darrin hover over Samantha, warning her not to exert herself. Louise is all but forgotten, but makes several unsuccessful attempts to tell Larry that he is to be a father. Finally, Samantha tells Larry. He is overjoyed. Although Darrin doesn't tell Samantha about his reverie, he is reassured when she tells him she hopes they have a child who looks just like him.

programme.desc: Tabitha gets an assist from her grandmother when Endora casts a spell that turns her into a 7year-old super genius.

programme.title: Bewitched

programme.desc: Samantha and Darrin argue over the use of witchcraft in an ad campaign.

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: Old Chines proverb: Witch should blink softly and never touch cinnamon stick.

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.sub-title: The Truth, Nothing But The Truth, So Help Me Sam
programme.desc: Endora casts a "truth spell" on a gift from Darrin to Samantha that causes everyone embarrassment.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.sub-title: I, Darrin, Take This Witch Samantha
programme.desc: Samantha and Darrin appear to be an ideally matched couple. Very much in love, they decide to marry. Darrin doesn't know that Samantha, is, of all things, a witch. On their wedding night, Samantha's mother, Endora, a witch, of course, visits her daughter. Regretting that her daughter has married a mortal, she is bent on breaking up the marriage. After pleading with her mother not to interfere, Samantha decides to tell her husband that he has unknowingly married a witch. To convince Darrin of her magic powers, Samantha performs a series of tricks. Darrin makes her promise never to practice her witchcraft again. Sheila, a former girl friend of Darrin's, invites the newly-weds to a dinner party. She makes every effort to embarrass Samantha before the guests. After enduring Sheila's snubs and insults, Samantha cannot resist evening the score. She employs her extraordinary powers to humiliate Sheila. Later, at home, Darrin rebukes his wife, but admits Sheila deserved the tricks played on her.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Endora is disgusted when Samantha refuses to use supernatural powers to cope with the routine tasks of a suburban housewife.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Endora is disgusted when Samantha refuses to use supernatural powers to cope with the routine tasks of a suburban housewife.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.sub-title: It Shouldn't Happen to a Dog
programme.desc: Samantha gives a dinner party to impress Rex Barker, one of Darrin's clients. Rex brings along his date, Babs Livingston, but advances on Samantha in the garden when he gets drunk.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Gladys Kravitz, a neighbor, is unable to convince her husband, Abner, that strange things seem to be happening at the Stephens' home. Gladys, June Foster, and Shirley Clyde, with their sons, visit the Stephens' home to welcome Samantha to the community. Gladys is frustrated in her attempts to point out to her friends the amazing number of objects which seem to appear and disappear. When the boys pester Endora, Samantha's mother, she uses magic to tie the three of them up. On leaving, Gladys tries to point out to her friends that it would be physically impossible for three boys to tie themselves up. Later Darrin returns home for his first meeting with Endora. Endora and Darrin soon engage in a heated argument about their opposing viewpoints on life. Endora threatens to turn Darrin into as artichoke. Later Samantha expresses her love for Darrin by announcing that if Endora had done so, she would also have turned herself into an artichoke.

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: Darrin struggles for days to create an advertising campaign for Caldwell Soup. Samantha's suggestions seem perfect, but Darrin's pride leads him to suspect Witchcraft. Stubborn, Darrin presents his own ideas to Phillip Caldwell, who rejects them. Samantha, worn out with housework, is stung when Darrin accuses her of using witchcraft to do that too. Endora, Samantha's mother, who dislikes Darrin, is pleased when the couple quarrels, and Samantha, packing in her own curious fashion, walks out. Crushed at losing his wife and a client in one week, Darrin submits Samantha's ideas to Larry Tate, his boss, who thinks they are great. Tate is bewildered when Darrin ecstatically accepts Caldwell's rejection and dashes home to make up with Samantha. Darrin then uses Samantha's chance remark as the basin for a successful Caldwell Soup campaign, blissfully unaware that Samantha planned it just that way.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Darrin discovers that Samantha has been entertaining a guest each morning after he leaves for work. the guest is ten year old Marshall Burns. Marshall's mother is a widow, whose over-protectiveness has robbed Marshall of all his self-confidence. Darrin tells Samantha that she has no right to interfere with Mrs. Burns' upbringing of her son. Despite Marshall's belief that he is no good at anything, Samantha takes him to a Junior League ball game. Marshall has never been able to make the team. Floyd Kravitz, nephew of Gladys Kravitz, is the star player. With a little witchery on Samantha's part, Marshall becomes a triple threat. When his mother, fearful that he may be inured, forbids him to play, Marshall runs away from home. Samantha and Darrin drive Mrs. Burns to the ball field. There, Marshall, in his own right, has continued to star. How-ever, when Marshall gets into a tight spot, Darrin forbids Samantha from interfering. Marshall makes it on his own. Proud of her son, Mrs. Burns is not unhappy when Coach Gribben suggests that he visit the Burns home to give Marshall some extra coaching.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Samantha, her friends, Bertha and Mary, and her Aunt Clara, all witches, decide to change the popular conception of witches into a more flattering image. Their opportunity arises when Darrin, an ad man, is assigned to devise a trademark for a new type of Halloween candy. Mr. Brinkman, the promoter of the candy, wants the trademark to show a traditional witch. Darrin at first agrees, but when he sees how upset Samantha becomes, he decides to present a beautiful witch. Mr. Brinkman objects, but Darrin refuses to yield. Con-sequently, he is fired. The witches decide to practice some of their pranks on Mr. Brinkman. As a topper, they transform him into an ugly old witch. Mr. Brinkman finally admits that his idea of witches is wrong. He agrees to use a glamorous witch for his trademark. Samantha wins her point, and Darrin wins back his job.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Teenager Liza Randall interviews Darrin about his career in advertising for a school newspaper. After Darrin takes Liza to the agency on Saturday, Liza's jealous boy friend, Marvin "Monster" Grogan, visits Samantha. Monster, a football star, wants to batter Darrin. Samantha, stuffing Monster with food, explains the innocence of Darrin and Lisa's relationship, although she knows Liza is more than interested in Darrin. At the office, Liza pours drinks. Liza and Darrin are doused when Darrin tries to take the drink away from her. Darrin escapes an awkward situation when boss Larry Tate arrives with two prospective clients . Meanwhile, Monster takes a romantic interest in Samantha. Darrin and Liza arrive, reeking of liquor. Darrin accuses Samantha of playing up to Monster. Samantha taunts him about Liza. However, when Monster winds up to clout Darrin, he bruises his hands on the invisible shield Samantha has created. When Liza slaps Darrin, however, Samantha lets him get the full force of the blow. Later Samantha removes her own protective shield when Darrin tries to make up.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Darrin's workload piles sky-high when Larry Tate and his wife Louise fly to Paris to cover the fashion showings- for a client. Samantha spends most of the time alone playing solitaire. She accepts Endora's invitation to fly to Paris, without a plane, of course, for lunch. In Paris, Samantha and Endora run into the Tates. Larry is surprised, phones Darrin that Samantha and her mother are in Paris with them. Samantha returns home immediately. Darrin tells Samantha their marriage is a mistake, since he has taken her away from all the high living she seems to love. Although Samantha tries to convinces Darrin that he is wrong, she angrily leaves, and returns to Paris. Larry Tate tells Darrin Samantha is lonesome for him. Darrin decides to follow her to Paris. After several unsuccessful tries, Samantha gets on Darrin's plane, and they arrive in Paris together.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Endora tells Samantha that Maurice, her father, is coming to visit. Endora warns Samantha that Maurice will be furious when he learns his daughter has married a mortal. Samantha, determined to stand up to her father, gets Darrin to stay in town on the night Maurice calls. Samantha tells Maurice that her husband is in Washington. The conversation about Darrin proceeds nicely until Maurice surmises Darrin is a mortal. Meanwhile, Darrin, who has been drinking with Larry Tate, phones Samantha and tells her he is coming home. When Darrin arrives, Maurice's fury hits its peak. Al-though Maurice admires Darrin's courage in facing up to him, he makes him disappear. Samantha, expressing her love for Darrin, pleads with Maurice to bring him back. Even Endora joins in Samantha's pleas. Although he tells them it will be extremely difficult, Maurice makes Darrin reappear. Before leaving, Maurice joins his family in a champagne toast. Im-pressed by the rare vintage, Maurice feels Darrin might be one of them after all.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.sub-title: It Takes One To Know One
programme.desc: When Darrin starts searching for a "Miss Jasmine" for his firm's perfume account, Endora seizes the opportunity to sew doubt in Samantha's mind about her husband's loyalty. The search for a beautiful model ends when Jannine Fleur arrives. Both Larry and Darrin agree that Jannine is "Miss Jasmine." Samantha learns that Jannine is a witch whom Endora has asked to captivate Darrin. Samantha warns Jannine to keel away from Darrin. Jannine, intrigued, keeps on with her original assign-ment. Darrin uses Larry Tate as his chaperone to keep him from becoming involved with Jannine. Darrin and Larry go to Jannine's apartment to discuss details of the "Miss Jasmine" campaign. Jannine doctors the drinks. Larry falls asleep and Darrin becomes amorous. Just as Darrin starts to kiss Jannine, Samantha uses her witchcraft, and Darrin appears to Jannine as a large ugly fish. When the campaign is completed, Samantha turns the picture of "Miss Jasmine" into a caricature of Jannine.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Learning that Dr. Bellows has told General Peterson that Tony should marry for his emotional stability as an astronaut, Jeannie prepares for the wedding. She produces Phoney, a twin of Tony's, who starts romancing her as an example for Tony. Getting nowhere, Jeannie makes Phoney disappear. Later, Dr. Bellows sees a romantic interlude between Jeannie and Phoney and leaves Tony's house, certain a wedding has been set for the following Sunday afternoon. Although Tony tries to get out of his predicament, he realizes he is stuck when the General congratulates him on his coming wedding. Later, Tony tells Jeannie he is going through with the affair.Jeannie produces Phoney to show Tony how to act at the wedding. Phoney tries to get Jeannie to marry him before she makes him vanish. At the chapel, Jeannie runs away at the last moment. At home, Tony tries unsuccessfully to make Jeannie believe it was actually Phoney who appeared at the wedding. Sure it was Tony, Jeannie tells she ran away after deciding never to force herself on him. When Tony musingly asks what would happen had they gotten married, Jeannie insinuates he will never know.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.sub-title: Get Me To Mecca On Time
programme.desc: Jeannie finds her strength and power to perform magic weakening. Tony makes her promise to rest during the day. At the base, Roger, pointing to an astrological chart in a magazine, tells Tony his horoscope shows a gorgeous brunette will enter Roger's life. Tony questions his belief in such nonsense. Later, Jeannie phones Tony and tells him she seems to be vanishing by degrees. Then she pops into his office. Reading Roger's magazine, she tells Tony it is the Day of the Ram, on which every Genie and her master must pilgrimage to Mecca, and standing in a precise spot, repeat the Sacred Words. Tony refuses to take her seriously, but begins to wonder when Roger introduces him to Diane, a beautiful brunette. Tony and Jeannie take off for Mecca.Since the city has changed, they run into difficulty locating the place where they must pronounce the Sacred Words. They find the place they are looking for is now a bank and break in. As they are about to be taken by the police, Jeannie begins to fade. Tony finds the correct spot and pronounces the incantation. Jeannie recovers and they leave for home. Thanking Tony for saving her life, Jeannie announces she is taking them to Paris for dinner. Deciding they have traveled enough for one day, Tony takes her to Cocoa Beach instead.

programme.title: South Park: Kun for medlemmer
programme.desc: Den nyvalgte præsident besøger sin hjemby.

programme.desc: Bebe er den første pige i fjerde, der 'udvikler sig', hvilket truer drengenes venskab og samfundet generelt.

programme.title: South Park: Kinaproblemer
programme.desc: Foruroliget af de olympiske ceremoniers storhed, beder Cartmann Butters om hjælp til at konfrontere kineserne. Samtidig er Stan og Kyle vidne til 'voldtægten' af Indianan Jones.

programme.title: South Park: Børnekidnapning er ikke sjovt
programme.desc: I et forsøg på at beskytte deres børn fra kidnappere, hyrer forældrene ejeren af City Wok for at bygge den Kinesiske Mur i South Park.

programme.title: South Park: Tilbage til rødderne
programme.desc: Butters begynder en rejse, der skal følge i sporene på hans hawaiianske forfædre.

programme.title: South Park: Mr. Hankey, julebæen
programme.desc: Borgmesteren beslutter at indføre et neutralt helligdagstema, som ikke kan fornærme nogen. Kyle mener, at han har svaret.

programme.title: South Park: Kenny dør
programme.desc: Kenny bliver dødeligt syg, og stakkels Stan har svært ved at klare det.

programme.title: South Park: Chef går bananas
programme.desc: Chef erklærer, at South Parks flag er racistisk. Stan og Kyle leder den gruppe, der støtter det nuværende flag, mens Wendy og Cartman slutter sig til dem, som går ind for et nyt flag.

programme.title: South Park: Scooterne
programme.desc: Børnene vil bruge det seneste i transportmidler for at få mere slik til Halloween end nogensinde før.

programme.title: South Park: En History Channel-thanksgiving
programme.desc: Da drengene prøver at lære alt om Thanksgiving ved at se History Channel, bliver de rodet ind i et mysterium der involverer aliens, Natalie Portman og indmad!

programme.title: South Park: The Worldwide Privacy Tour
programme.desc: Prinsen af Canada og hans kone forsøger at beskytte deres privatliv i en lille bjergby.

programme.desc: Mr. Garrison får omsider en kønsskifteoperation, og Kyle får en ret 'ualmindelig' operation, der skal gøre ham atletisk og høj nok til at spille på basketballholdet.

programme.title: South Park: Fiskefingre
programme.desc: Jimmy er vred over, at Cartman prøver at tage æren for en joke, som han fandt på, der nu er blevet populær i hele landet. Men en vred Kanye West kan ikke forstå pointen.

programme.title: South Park: Surt for Cartman
programme.desc: Butters bliver sendt til en speciel lejr for 'Pray the Gay Away', efter han er blevet grebet i en kompromitterende situation med Cartman. Cartman prøver at få fat i et billede af situationen.

programme.desc: Der foregår ulovlige ting i kælderen under City Wok.

programme.desc: Uvidende og evigt uskyldige Butters starter 'Kyssefirmaet' og bliver snart den mest berygtede alfons.

programme.desc: I bedste Wham-tradition, er de opblæste canadiske superstjerner Terrance og Phillip gået hvert til sit på grund af kunstneriske uoverensstemmelser.

programme.title: South Park: Canada strejker
programme.desc: Canada er på randen af sammenbrud efter en langtrukken strejke, der drejer sig om 'nogle af de internetpenge'.

programme.title: South Park: Trapper Keeper
programme.desc: Cartman har fået en ny Trapper Keeper. Da han har pralet af den, fortæller en fremmed ham, at den snart vil overtage verden, hvis de ikke destruerer den nu.

programme.title: South Park: Professor Chaos
programme.desc: Drengene fyrer Butters som deres ven, og vækker hans mørke side.

programme.title: South Park: Universets største nar
programme.desc: Da et berømt spititistik medium ikke kan mane Kenny ud af Cartmans krop, forsøger Chefs mor lidt voodoomagi på ham selv.

programme.title: South Park: Tsst!
programme.desc: Da det går op for Cartmans mor, at hun ikke længere kan kontrollere sin søn, får hun hjælp fra en ekspert. Cesar Millan, 'Hundehviskeren' tager udfordringen op.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Central Jutland
programme.desc: Volcanoes and glaciers shaped this part of the country, leaving a giant fjord and pre-historic fossils in their wake. Farmers and food innovators work closely with nature to prepare food with the area’s plentiful herbs and award-winning seafood.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Åland (Part 2)
programme.desc: Tareq goes back to Åland to explore more of this island territory. Tareq finds a chef setting up a huge food village, sees forts left over from various invaders over the centuries, and learns about beer being recreated from 200 year old DNA.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Tornedalen
programme.desc: There are not many places like Tornedalen. A rushing river has provided for locals for centuries, and the very fertile land has yielded amazing crops for centuries.Tareq explores the traditions and the food that are part of the short summer season.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: North Jutland
programme.desc: At the northern-most part of Denmark, you are always close to raw, beautiful nature, and incredible sunlight that has drawn artists here for over 100 years. Tareq visits a salt maker using medieval techniques and experiences the magic light of Skagen.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: East Denmark
programme.desc: East Denmark contains some of Denmark’s most fertile lands, and many traditional farmers are converting to organic production and winning awards for their cheeses and wine. Tareq bikes through an area of limestone cliffs and Viking ships.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Kristianstad
programme.desc: Located in Sweden’s south, beautiful Kristianstad is a 400-year old town surrounded by the ocean, fertile farmland and protected wetlands to aid the environment. Tareq makes his own chocolate and learns all about the art of eel-fishing.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Southwest Jutland
programme.desc: Tareq visits Sydvestjylland – a unique area in Denmark filled with endless contrasts. Many food innovators are using the surrounding environment to take old traditions and apply them to the 21st century.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Nynäshamn
programme.desc: Sunny Nynäshamn is a resort town close to Stockholm, but there is more here than the sea. Tareq meets a prize-winning chocolate maker using ingredients from her garden, visits a thriving local food market, and gets a lesson in how to smoke fish.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Røros
programme.desc: Born as a mining town in the 17th century, Røros is now a center for local and organic food producers. Tareq tries dairy products which Michelin-starred chefs swear by, goes skiing and sledding around Røros many hilly streets

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Vimmerby
programme.desc: Vimmerby is known as the birthplace of beloved author Astrid Lindgren. Tareq finds that the area is also well-regarded for its cuisine. From the children’s theme park to the friendly moose that roam the hills, Vimmerby has a lot to offer visitors.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Trysil
programme.desc: The mountains and snowfall in Trysil mean that the town has to be creative with food; Tareq learns how to make cheese in the traditional way, and goes skiing of course, and takes to the slopes to cook something as skiers pass by.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Värmland
programme.desc: Värmland is home to many of Sweden’s most famous authors and inventors. However, it is also a place with a rich food culture. Tareq gets his hands on a very rare bird to cook and also takes time out to float down a tranquil river on a wooden raft.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Fyn
programme.desc: Tareq visits Fyn, the fairy tale capital of the world. Famous as the birthplace of Hans Christian Andersen, Fyn is also known as the garden of Denmark. Here we explore stunning nature and world class cuisine.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Höga Kusten
programme.desc: Created thousands of years ago, the High Coast in the northern part of Sweden is the highest coast in the world. Tareq sets out to sample one of the most extreme types of Swedish food, fermented herring.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: North Denmark
programme.desc: North Jutland has a rich culinary history. The unique conditions have created equally unique products. Tareq meets local food entrepreneurs who have learned to adapt to this ever changing environment and putting this region on the culinary map.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Uppsala
programme.desc: Uppsala is the city of knowledge: home to the oldest university in Scandinavia. It’s a wonderful agricultural area surrounded by fertile flatlands. Tareq discovers the historical treasures of Uppsala and its thriving culinary life.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: North Sealand
programme.desc: North Zealand has been a playground of the rich and famous since the fifteenth century. Tareq learns how this beautiful north eastern part of Denmark is the perfect place to go foraging for wild berries and herbs.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Åre
programme.desc: Sweden’s largest ski resort Åre is well known for its local ingredients, boasting the highest number of organic food producers per capita in Sweden. The fresh water and clean air create unique conditions for growing excellent food.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: The Danish Lakelands
programme.desc: The Danish Lakelands produce some of the finest ingredients that you can find. Tareq has a go at an old cooking technique from New Zealand called Hangi - using heated rocks buried in a pit oven.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: West Sweden
programme.desc: Gothenburg on the west coast of Sweden has recently been discovered as an exciting destination by both international travel journalists and food bloggers. Tareq tracks down an old army barracks which has been converted into a world class cheese factory.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Luleå
programme.desc: Tareq visits Luleå, home to the beautiful Tree Hotel: a collection of treehouses built by an award winning architect. Following the river further up into the mountains he reaches the land where, for centuries, the Sami people kept their reindeer herds.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Halmstad
programme.desc: In Halmstad Tareq explores the contrast between the busy summer scene at the beach and the quiet rural country life, meeting Jörgen Persson: award winning table tennis player and visiting a village famous for its cheese.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Kemi
programme.desc: Kemi is situated in northern Finland by the Bothnian Bay and it is part of Lapland region. Tareq tries his luck at a spot of burbot fishing on the frozen sea and visits the snow castle hotel.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: West Sweden
programme.desc: Situated on the west coast of Sweden, Bohuslän is a place where you can really feel the history of fishing all around a tradition that is still active. Tareq will be harvesting supreme quality oysters and lobsters and cook some wonderful seafood dishes.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Florø
programme.desc: Tareq visits Norway and Florø to celebrate their national day -17th of May. Surrounded by breathtaking archipelagos and stunning fjords he dives for scallops in the north sea, cooking at mountain peaks and exploring the history of norwegian salmon

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Estonia
programme.desc: Tareq makes his way across the baltic sea to Estonia and the capital Tallinn. He discovers the historical treasures of the city and its thriving culinary life before he heads out into the vast and beautiful countryside and the national park of Soomaa.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Ringkøbing
programme.desc: Ringkøbing, a lovely old market town located at the west coast of Denmark. Here, Tareq visit a traditional Herring Festival and meets up with local entrepreneurs who have learned to adapt to this ever-changing environment.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Falkenberg
programme.desc: Something is definitely happening in Falkenberg on the west coast of Sweden. Over the last couple of years it have become somewhat of a haven for foodies. Tareq is on a mission; taking him through a fertile landscape with vineyards and salmon fishing.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Estonia (Part 2)
programme.desc: Estonia has embarked on a journey greatly inspired by the nordic cuisine. Tareq explores the countryside of Estonia before he returns to the capital of Tallinn where he meets people that really love their traditional food.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Öland
programme.desc: Tareq bikes through the unique landscape of Öland, Sweden's second largest island located in the Baltic Sea. It is a place where the interaction between man and nature have created a diverse and rich farmland with an amazing amount of small producers.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Bornholm
programme.desc: Bornholm, the sunny bright green island with it’s own gastronomic tone is a true pioneer when it comes to local food at it’s finest quality. Tareq visit Denmark's first regional food culture house where they develop this unique flourishing cuisine.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Bornholm
programme.desc: Bornholm, the sunny bright green island with it’s own gastronomic tone is a true pioneer when it comes to local food at it’s finest quality. Tareq visit Denmark's first regional food culture house where they develop this unique flourishing cuisine.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Laponia
programme.desc: In the northern part of Sweden, you’ll find the stunning world heritage Laponia. Almost 10.000 square kilometres of nature reserves and national parks. Tareq visit the rich, unique culture of the sami in the vast impressive wilderness.

programme.title: The Hills: Back To New York
programme.desc: Whitney tager til New York i forventning om at møde Alex igen, men en ny fyr ved navn Jay fanger hendes opmærksomhed. Heidi er ulykkelig efter fyringen, men da Spencer taler med Brent for at skaffe hende jobbet tilbage, forværrer han situationen.

programme.title: The Hills: One Last Chance
programme.desc: Lauren lader Heidis søster overnatte. Justin inviterer Audrina med på en romantisk weekend, og Heidis frustration med Spencer vokser, da hun må tigge for at få sit job tilbage.

programme.title: The Hills: You Did This
programme.desc: Audrina tror på et rygte, hun hører: at Lauren har kysset med Justin. I mellemtiden prøver Holly at få Heidi væk fra Spencer.

programme.title: The Hills: It's About Trust
programme.desc: Audrina forsøger at redde sit venskab med Lauren efter at have anklaget hende for at have kysset med Justin. Spencer og Stephanie besøger deres bedstemore, som er træt af, at de skændes.

programme.title: The Hills: Dream Boy, Dream Job
programme.desc: Whitney bliver tilbudt en chance for a score sit drømmejob NYC og håber at se Jay der. Lauren bliver nostalgisk, da hendes forældre sælger huset i Laguna Beach, og Stephanie går til Spencer for at få hjælp med Cameron.

programme.title: The Hills: Mr. & Mrs. Pratt
programme.desc: Spencer og Heidi ignorerer deres bekymrede familier og stikker af til Mexico for at blive gift. Whitney går efter drømmejobbet i New York City, og siger farvel til Lauren og sit liv i Los Angeles.

programme.title: The Hills: I Heidi Take Thee Spencer
programme.desc: Lauren og Heidi mødes og husker, hvorfor de plejede at være venner. Spencer og Heidi er lige blevet gift, da Heidis mor kommer til byen. Justin chokerer Audrina, da han tager hende med til Palm Springs til en overraskelse.

programme.title: The Hills: Don't Cry On Your Birthday
programme.desc: Da Heidi kommer uanmeldt til Laurens fødselsdagsfest, græder de to gamle venner over deres ødelagte venskab. Spencer kommer op at slås, da Cameron beskylder ham for at samle en bartender op.

programme.title: The Hills: Everything Happens for a Reason
programme.desc: Spencers flirtende opførsel får Heidi til at tage hjem til Colorado, hvor hun møder en gammel kæreste. Lauren skælder Stephanie ud for at have inviteret Heidi til festen. Spencer ender en lang stilhed med Brody.

programme.title: The Hills: I'm Done With You
programme.desc: Da Heidi overrasker Spencer på en natklub med bartenderen Stacie, forlanger hun, at de går i parterapi. Lauren risikerer sit rygte, da hun skaffer Stephanie en praktikplads hos People's Revolution.

programme.title: The Hills: Crazy In Love
programme.desc: Audrina prøver at komme sig over Justin ved at gå efter Brody. Heidi slæber en modvillig Spencer med til parterapi. Da Stephanie kvajer sig hos People's Revolution, truer Lauren med at fyre hende.

programme.title: The Hills: I Always Had A Little Crush
programme.sub-title: I Always Had A Little Crush
programme.desc: Audrina prøver at glemme Justin ved at score Brody, da pigerne tager med på drengenes surf-tur til Hawaii. Heidis uskyldige ekskæreste kommer på besøg, og hun håber, at hans værdier vil smitte af på Spencer.

programme.title: The Hills: Playmates Bring the Drama
programme.desc: Audrina bliver knust, da Brodys kæreste konfronterer hende om Hawaii og Brody ikke gør noget for at stoppe det. Heidi opsnapper en sms fra Stacie til Spencer og tager på natklub for at konfrontere hende.

programme.title: The Hills: Keep Your Enemies Closer
programme.desc: Justin konfronterer Audrina om at være sammen med Brody i Hawaii. Stephanie ødelægger en fotooptagelse på jobbet, så Lauren får skældud af Kelly. Bartenderen Stacie prøver at slutte fred med Heidi.

programme.title: The Hills: Father of The Bride
programme.desc: Spencer prøver at redde sit forhold til Heidi ved at bede hendes cowboyfar om tilladelse til at gifte sig med hende. Lauren må fyre Stephanie fra People's Revolution og risikerer deres venskab.

programme.title: The Hills: Hi Lauren, It's Spencer
programme.desc: Lauren overvejer, om hun skal tage til Heidis bryllup, efter Spencer omsider siger undskyld. Brody nægter at risikere sit forhold til Jayde for at redde sit forhold til Audrina, og Stephanie konfronterer Kelly Cutrone.

programme.title: The Hills: Something Old, Something New
programme.desc: I Laurens sidste afsnit, må hun beslutte, om hun er villig til at tilgive Spencer for at kunne være der for Heidi til hendes 'prinsesse'-bryllup. Alle de medvirkende dukker op og bliver chokeret af en overraskende gæst.

programme.title: The Hills: It's On Bitch
programme.desc: Kristin starter en krig, da hun lægger an på Justin lige foran Audrina. Spencer ser på huse med Heidi og køber et hus uden hendes godkendelse.

programme.title: The Hills: Mess With Me, I Mess With You
programme.sub-title: Mess With Me, I Mess With You
programme.desc: Da Audrina brænder Kristin af, beslutter hun sig for ikke at kæmpe imod sin tiltrækning af Justin. Heidi melder sig til at passe naboens barn, men Spencer vil ikke have noget med børn at gøre.

programme.title: The Hills: Strike One
programme.desc: Kristin får sin første forsmag på at være i et forhold med Justin, da han ikke dukker op til Brodys surprise party. Heidi og Spencer er uenige om, hvornår de skal starte en familie, og Audrina går på date med Justins bedste ven.

programme.title: The Hills: Old Habits Die Hard
programme.desc: Kristin tror, at hun har tæmmet Justin, men han har måske ikke glemt Audrina. Da Holly mister kontrollen til et event, må Heidi få sin søster til at konfrontere sit spiritusproblem.

programme.title: The Hills: Sorry Boo, Strike Two
programme.desc: Justin spiller kostbar med Kristin, men hans plan giver bagslag. Hollys druk fører til en intervention af Heidi og Stephanie. Brody og Jayde skændes og genovervejer deres forhold.

programme.title: The Hills: I'm Done With You
programme.desc: Justin er ude på dybt vand efter Kristin og Audrina endelig mødes ansigt til ansigt. Heidi vil have en baby til sin fødselsdag, men Spencer har noget andet i tankerne.

programme.title: The Hills: On To The Next
programme.desc: Kristin og Brody overvejer at date igen, men et møde med Jayde viser, det ikke er tid. Audrina og Justin mødes for at diskutere deres fremtid, men det ender ikke, som hun havde håbet. Spencer tager drastiske tiltag mod Heidis babybesættelse.

programme.title: The Hills: Can't Always Get What You Want
programme.sub-title: Can't Always Get What You Want
programme.desc: Kristin skændes med Jayde, fordi hun vil have Brody tilbage. Heidi planlægger at blive gravid med eller uden Spencers samtykke, Audrina må forholde sig til, at Justin stadig har følelser for Kristin.

programme.title: The Hills: Mr. Right Now
programme.desc: Kristin vil ikke være sammen med Justin, men han lader hende ikke gå uden at kæmpe. Audrina ender alt med Justin for altid. Brody får kolde fødder, da Jayde vil flytte sammen, og Spencer frygter, at Heidi måske er gravid.

programme.title: The Hills: The Boys Of Summer
programme.desc: Kristin og Justin beslutter at tage deres forhold til det næste niveau og Spencer konfronterer Heidi om en graviditetstest. Brody har måske stadig følelser for Kristin, efter Jayde konfronterer ham om deres forhold til en forlovelsesfest.

programme.title: The Hills: Put On A Happy Face
programme.desc: Heidis hjemkomst bliver ødelagt, da hendes mor kritiserer hendes plastikoperation. Kristin og pigerne tagr til Miami til Super Bowl-weekend, men stemningen bliver dårlig, da hun fester så hårdt, at det bekymrer Audrina, Lo og Stephanie.

programme.title: The Hills: Rumor Has It
programme.desc: Da rygterne går om Kristins partying får Stephanie skylden. Audrina begynder at date en ny fyr, men det stopper ikke Brody fra at prøve at score hende. Spencer bliver vred, da han møder Stephanie til Kristins fest.

programme.title: The Hills: The Elephant In The Room
programme.desc: Heidi arrangerer en fest for sin nabo, men den bliver overskygget af at Spencer flipper ud på Holly. Kristin opfordrer Audrina til at fokusere på Ryan, og prøver derefter at få et tættere forhold til Brody.

programme.title: The Hills: This Is Goodbye
programme.desc: Heidi og Spencers opførsel fører til, at deres venner og familie træffer et vanskeligt valg. Kristin og Brody kysser, men er enige om at fortsætte som singler. Ryan skuffer Audrina, da han ikke dukker op til en bytur.

programme.desc: Brody sætter sit venskab med Kristin på spil da han begynder at date en anden pige. Lo sender Stephanie ud på en dobbeldate. Ryan giver Audrinas venner en ny chance.
